title: command.form.submit props, contract version 1
description: The props of the decorator of the generic command form's submit, a decorator point (PRD 13.4): what the form is about, the command's name, its contract version and the title of its JSON Schema. A contribution to it adds content around the form's actions and a badge, and tightens a disabled reason, which blocks the submit and so mirrors a hook of its addon, a description and a tone towards danger. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\CommandForm\Domain\Dto\CommandFormSubmitV1.

command.description: The name of the command the form runs, such as entry.create: lowercase segments in snake_case joined by dots, at least two.

title.description: The title of the command's JSON Schema, such as "entry.create, contract version 1".

version.description: The contract version of the command the form runs, 1 or more.
